# Alex Leung

> Personal website and writing archive by Alex Leung, a software engineer and writer.

## Site Map

- [Home](https://alexleung.ca/): Alex's software engineering work, writing, and interests
- [Now](https://alexleung.ca/now/): a dated snapshot of Alex's reading and everyday life
- [Writing](https://alexleung.ca/blog/): essays, technical notes, book notes, and personal reflections
- [Mandelbrot Explorer](https://alexleung.ca/experimental/mandelbrot/): an interactive fractal explorer with arbitrary-precision viewport coordinates and bounded deep zoom
- [PID Controller Simulator](https://alexleung.ca/experimental/pid-controller/): tune a heated plate, spring–mass system, or draining tank; watch its motion alongside the response curve and compare snapshots
- [Load Flow Analysis](https://alexleung.ca/experimental/load-flow/): adjust electrical loads and inspect active/reactive power, bus voltages, and phase angles on a single-line diagram
- [Ray-tracing Room](https://alexleung.ca/experimental/ray-tracing/): move a light, change materials, and inspect sampled paths through reflections and refractions
- [Content-aware Resizing](https://alexleung.ca/experimental/seam-carving/): compare seam carving with scaling and cropping, with painted protection and local image uploads
- [Contact](https://alexleung.ca/contact/): ways to reach Alex and follow new writing

## Writing

The blog covers software projects, AI tools and workflows, book notes, and personal notes on moving, travel, study, and life outside work.

## Background

Alex's software work has spanned embedded systems, distributed systems, AI product development, and full-stack product engineering. His previous work includes home electrification, AR/AI hardware, and consumer finance.

He holds a Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Georgia Institute of Technology and a Bachelor of Applied Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of Waterloo. He is a licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) through Professional Engineers Ontario.
